scope: Local rendering of synthetic fixture; read-only external GETs; no external POST or new paste.

upstream.execution: Original Go renderer; package renamed to main; stdin + httptest.ResponseRecorder wrapper, no server or database. Go 1.27.3 portable in temp; official archive SHA256 verified.

input: Public export of tests/test_public_team_pastes.py EXAMPLE_TEAM, captured after app/application/pokepaste.py via httpx.MockTransport. Fixture matches the owner example plus public Level: 50.

browser.method: Fulfilled one intercepted synthetic HTML document with local upstream output. Original Pokepast.es CSS/images fetched with GET; all non-GET browser requests aborted.
browser.visual_inspection: Six correct species, nicknames, item icons and four colored moves each; no private fields.

limitations: Local upstream renderer verification is not a post-deployment end-to-end Discord test.

Pokepast.es data has gaps, including Furfrou trims, several Pikachu hats, Unown letters, cosmetic gender art (e.g. Pyroar F uses the same 668-0 image), Vise Grip, Conversion 2 and some item icons. Correct Showdown identities were preserved.
No existing stored paste URLs were reset or regenerated.

tests.environment: Windows, .venv-api Python 3.14; tools/run_unit_tests.py isolated temporary SQLite and no live credentials
tests.selection: 124 tracked test modules from git ls-files tests/test*.py; unittest TestLoader.discover replaced with loadTestsFromNames of those modules. Untracked owner tests excluded.
tests.pythonpath: Repository root and tests directory, inherited by subprocess tests
tests.lint: No new findings. Unfiltered lint retains the 10 baseline C408 findings in the test harness; --ignore C408 passes.
tests.earlier_invocation_failures: Direct unittest import of phase9_fixtures, and three Launcher subprocess imports without tests in PYTHONPATH. Corrected invocation; final tracked suite passes.
